name: Media Downloader
description: Paste a link from YouTube or 1,000+ other sites and choose exactly what to download: every available video quality (4K, 1080p, 720p…) with size estimates, or the audio stream to save as MP3/M4A/Opus/FLAC. Playlists, cover art and subtitles supported. WebDeck installs yt-dlp and FFmpeg for you on first use.
author: WebDeck
